entries.scenario: Packaged Java Life Agent multi-surface product demo: outcome request, Java task creation, choice, commitment boundary, handoff, execution state, outcome, settings, and live MCP App resource reads
entries.environment: Tavall Life Agent DEVELOPMENT; clean packaged Java distribution on loopback 127.0.0.1:3310
entries.serviceProvider: Life Agent Java MCP and loopback NoAuth development demo servlet
entries.action: The browser operator submitted the trip-preparation outcome in the real Life Agent demo, invoked Java life_plan, chose a route, invoked Java life_request_action for Calendar and Gmail, and navigated the resulting Glass UI surfaces before loading live Java MCP tools and resources.
entries.authoritativeVerification: The Java MCP response created and persisted the task, returned WAITING_FOR_HUMAN for both provider actions, and tools/list/resources/list returned 11 Java tools and 7 Java-owned MCP App resources; selected resource documents were read from the running Java endpoint and rendered in the MCP surface preview.

entries.scenario: Outcome planning, provider capability routing, approval boundary, safe Calendar event and Gmail draft verification
entries.environment: Tavall Cloud DEVELOPMENT; committed packaged Java Life Agent over loopback MCP; connected Google test identity
entries.serviceProvider: Google Calendar primary calendar and Gmail
entries.action: Java life_plan and life_provider_capabilities routed the travel-preparation outcome; Java life_request_action recorded Calendar and Gmail actions as WAITING_FOR_HUMAN. The connected host provider boundaries created a private disposable Calendar event and an unsent self-addressed Gmail draft.
entries.authoritativeVerification: google_calendar_read_event returned the event ID, private visibility, and exact time; gmail_read_email returned the message with DRAFT label and sent=false; gmail_list_drafts returned the matching draft. Both temporary provider records were moved/removed after capture.
